title: Late invoice payment
title_vi: Thanh toán hóa đơn bị trễ
lines: Hi, this message is for Daniel Park in the accounts team. This is Rachel Moore from Brightline Retail.
I'm calling about invoice number 4471, which your company sent us on March third.
I just wanted to give you a heads-up that our payment is going to be a little late this month.
We're switching to a new accounting system, and all of our payments have been on hold since Monday.
Our finance director has assured me that everything should be up and running again by next Wednesday.
So you can expect the full amount, about twelve thousand dollars, by the end of next week.
I know this isn't ideal, and I'm really sorry for the inconvenience.
Believe me, we're as frustrated as you are.
In the meantime, could you send me a copy of the invoice by e-mail?
Our new system needs a digital version, and I can't seem to find the original.
You can reach me at 555-0193 if you have any questions.
Thanks so much, Daniel, and talk to you soon.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the message?
o: To request a discount on an invoice
questions.vi: Câu "give you a heads-up that our payment is going to be a little late" cho thấy mục đích là báo thanh toán bị trễ. Bẫy: có nhắc "invoice" nhưng không xin giảm giá.

questions.q: Why has the payment been delayed?
o: The company is changing its accounting system
The bank was closed on Monday
questions.vi: "We're switching to a new accounting system" = đổi hệ thống kế toán. Bẫy: "Monday" có xuất hiện nhưng là ngày bắt đầu tạm dừng thanh toán, không phải ngân hàng đóng cửa.

questions.q: Why does the speaker say, "Believe me, we're as frustrated as you are"?
o: To show she understands the listener's situation
To complain about her finance director
To ask for an extra month to pay
To deny that the invoice was received
questions.vi: Sau lời xin lỗi "I'm really sorry for the inconvenience", câu này thể hiện sự đồng cảm với người nghe. Bẫy: "finance director" có trong bài nhưng cô không phàn nàn về ông ấy.

questions.q: What does the speaker ask the listener to do?
o: Send an electronic copy of a document
questions.vi: "could you send me a copy of the invoice by e-mail?" = gửi bản điện tử của hóa đơn. Bẫy: "next Wednesday" là ngày hệ thống chạy lại, không phải hẹn gặp.

title: Weekend system maintenance
title_vi: Bảo trì hệ thống cuối tuần
lines: Good afternoon, everyone. This is Tom from the IT operations team with a quick announcement.
This Saturday, we'll be carrying out planned maintenance on our main database servers.
The work will start at ten p.m. on Saturday and should be finished by six a.m. on Sunday.
During that time, the customer portal and the internal HR system will be unavailable.
E-mail and chat won't be affected, so you can still contact each other as usual.
If you're on call this weekend, please note that alerts will be paused for the duration of the maintenance.
Before you leave on Friday, make sure you save any open work and log out of all internal tools.
Anything left unsaved may be lost when the servers restart.
We'll send a confirmation e-mail as soon as everything is back online.
And if you notice any problems on Sunday morning, please submit a ticket through the help desk rather than messaging the team directly.
That way, we can track and prioritize issues more efficiently.
Thanks for your patience, and have a great weekend.

questions.q: Who most likely is the speaker?
questions.vi: "This is Tom from the IT operations team" → nhân viên IT. Bẫy: "HR system" và "database" có trong bài nhưng không nói về nghề của người nói.

questions.q: When will the maintenance be completed?
questions.vi: "should be finished by six a.m. on Sunday". Bẫy: "ten p.m. on Saturday" là giờ bắt đầu, không phải giờ kết thúc.

questions.q: What will still be available during the maintenance?
questions.vi: "E-mail and chat won't be affected" → công cụ nhắn tin vẫn dùng được (paraphrase). Bẫy: portal, HR system không dùng được; alerts "will be paused".

questions.q: What are listeners asked to do before leaving on Friday?
o: Save their work and log out
questions.vi: "save any open work and log out of all internal tools". Bẫy: "submit a ticket" là việc làm nếu có lỗi sáng Chủ nhật.

title: Daily stand-up update
title_vi: Cập nhật họp stand-up hằng ngày
lines: Morning, everyone. Let's keep this quick, since a few of us have the client demo at ten thirty.
Yesterday, we closed out eleven of the fourteen tickets in the sprint backlog, so only three are still open, and we're in pretty good shape.
Those three are all related to the payment module.
Minh found the root cause of the checkout bug last night, so that fix should be merged by noon.
The bad news is that the staging server went down again at around two a.m.
Operations says it's a disk space issue and they're on it, but they can't give us an exact time.
So, if you were planning to test on staging this morning, you might want to hold off.
Use your local environment for now, and I'll post in the team channel once it's back.
One more thing: the sprint review has been pushed from Thursday to Friday at three, because the product owner is traveling.
That actually gives us an extra day, which we definitely need.
If anyone's blocked, grab me right after this call rather than waiting until the afternoon.
Okay, that's it from me. Over to you, Minh.

questions.q: What is the speaker mainly doing?
o: Giving her team a progress update
Presenting a product to a client
Reporting a server problem to operations
questions.vi: Đây là buổi stand-up: "we closed out eleven of the fourteen tickets..." → cập nhật tiến độ cho nhóm. Bẫy: "client demo" diễn ra lúc 10:30, không phải bây giờ.

questions.q: How many tickets are still unfinished?
questions.vi: Người nói: "only three are still open" → còn 3 ticket. Bẫy: 11 (đã xong) và 14 (tổng) cũng được nghe thấy.

questions.q: Why does the speaker say, "you might want to hold off"?
o: To ask staff to postpone merging a fix
To recommend waiting until the demo ends
To warn that the product owner is unavailable
To advise against using a system that is down
questions.vi: Staging server "went down" nên cô khuyên đừng test trên staging lúc này. Bẫy: "merged by noon" và "product owner is traveling" là thông tin khác.

questions.q: What will most likely happen next?
questions.vi: "Over to you, Minh" → Minh (đồng nghiệp) sẽ nói tiếp. Bẫy: sprint review đã dời sang thứ Sáu lúc 3 giờ, demo lúc 10:30.

title: New engineering manager
title_vi: Giới thiệu quản lý kỹ thuật mới
lines: Okay, everyone, before we get started, I'd like to introduce a new member of our team.
This is Priya Sharma, who's joining us as our new engineering manager.
Priya comes to us from Nexora, where she led a team of twenty developers for six years.
She has a lot of experience with cloud infrastructure and mobile apps, which is exactly what we need right now.
Starting next Monday, Priya will be in charge of both the backend team and the mobile team.
So going forward, please send your weekly reports to her instead of me.
I'll still be around, of course, but I'll be focusing on our new partnership projects.
Priya would like to meet each of you individually over the next two weeks.
She'll send out calendar invitations later today, so please accept one that works for you.
Also, we're having a small welcome lunch for her this Friday at the Italian place across the street.
Lunch is on the company, so I hope everyone can make it.
Now, Priya, would you like to say a few words?

questions.q: What is the purpose of the talk?
o: To describe a new mobile app
questions.vi: "I'd like to introduce a new member of our team" → giới thiệu đồng nghiệp mới. Bẫy: "mobile apps", "weekly reports" chỉ là chi tiết phụ.

questions.q: How long did Priya work at Nexora?
questions.vi: "led a team of twenty developers for six years". Bẫy: "twenty" là số lập trình viên, "two weeks" là thời gian gặp riêng từng người.

questions.q: What are listeners asked to do going forward?
o: Send their weekly reports to Priya
questions.vi: "going forward, please send your weekly reports to her instead of me". Bẫy: "say a few words" là việc Priya được mời làm, không phải người nghe.

questions.q: What will happen on Friday?
o: Priya will start her new role
questions.vi: "a small welcome lunch for her this Friday" → cả nhóm ăn trưa cùng nhau. Bẫy: Priya bắt đầu phụ trách từ "next Monday"; lời mời lịch gửi "later today".

title: Gate change and delay
title_vi: Đổi cổng và hoãn chuyến bay
lines: Attention, please. This is an announcement for passengers on Skyways flight 382 to Singapore.
Due to a technical issue with the aircraft, this flight has been delayed.
The new departure time is eleven forty-five, about ninety minutes later than scheduled.
In addition, the flight will now depart from gate 27 instead of gate 12.
Gate 27 is in Terminal B, so please allow about fifteen minutes to walk there.
Boarding is expected to begin at eleven ten.
We know this isn't the news you were hoping for.
To make up for the inconvenience, passengers can collect a meal voucher worth fifteen dollars at the Skyways service desk.
Please have your boarding pass ready when you pick it up.
If you have a connecting flight in Singapore, our staff at the desk can help you rebook it if necessary.
We'll make further announcements if anything changes.
Thank you for your patience, and we apologize for the delay.

questions.q: Where is the announcement being made?
questions.vi: "passengers on Skyways flight 382", "depart from gate 27" → thông báo ở sân bay. Bẫy: "On an airplane" sai vì hành khách chưa lên máy bay.

questions.q: Where will the flight now depart from?
questions.vi: "depart from gate 27 instead of gate 12. Gate 27 is in Terminal B". Bẫy: gate 12 là cổng cũ; "fifteen" là số phút đi bộ.

questions.q: Why does the speaker say, "We know this isn't the news you were hoping for"?
o: To announce that the flight is cancelled
To report a change of destination
To ask passengers to board quickly
questions.vi: Sau khi báo hoãn chuyến và đổi cổng, câu này thừa nhận hành khách thất vọng. Bẫy: chuyến bay chỉ bị hoãn, không bị hủy.

questions.q: What should passengers bring to collect a voucher?
questions.vi: "Please have your boarding pass ready when you pick it up". Bẫy: "fifteen dollars" là giá trị phiếu ăn, không phải tiền phải mang.

title: Tech firm opens Asian office
title_vi: Công ty công nghệ mở văn phòng ở châu Á
lines: In business news today, Seattle-based software company Cloudvane has announced plans to open its first Asian office in Ho Chi Minh City.
The office, which will be located in the city's new technology park, is scheduled to open in September.
Cloudvane says it will hire around three hundred engineers there by the end of next year, and that number could double by 2028.
The company had originally considered Singapore and Bangkok, but chose Vietnam because of its large pool of young software developers.
Chief executive Laura Bennett said the move would allow the company to provide round-the-clock support to customers in different time zones.
Some analysts point out that competition for experienced engineers in the region is already intense.
Salaries for senior developers have risen by nearly twenty percent over the past two years.
Still, Cloudvane's shares rose four percent after the announcement.
The company plans to hold a recruitment event in the city in July, ahead of the opening.
Ms. Bennett will also meet with local university leaders to discuss internship programs.
Coming up after the break, we'll have the latest on the housing market.

questions.q: What is the news report mainly about?
o: A merger between two software firms
questions.vi: "open its first Asian office in Ho Chi Minh City" → mở rộng ra nước ngoài (paraphrase). Bẫy: Singapore và internship programs chỉ là chi tiết phụ.

questions.q: Why did Cloudvane choose Vietnam?
o: It is close to its customers
questions.vi: "because of its large pool of young software developers" = có nhiều lập trình viên. Bẫy: "customers in different time zones" là lợi ích của việc hỗ trợ 24/7, không phải lý do chọn Việt Nam.

questions.q: Why does the speaker say, "not everyone is convinced"?
o: To report that shareholders rejected the plan
To suggest that the opening will be delayed
To indicate that some experts have doubts
To show that local officials oppose the project
questions.vi: Câu tiếp theo "Some analysts point out that competition... is already intense" → một số chuyên gia nghi ngờ. Bẫy: cổ phiếu lại tăng 4%, nên cổ đông không phản đối.

questions.q: What will happen in July?
o: Shares will be offered to staff
A hiring event will be held
questions.vi: "hold a recruitment event in the city in July" = sự kiện tuyển dụng (paraphrase). Bẫy: văn phòng mở vào "September", không phải tháng 7.

title: Interview invitation
title_vi: Lời mời phỏng vấn từ nhà tuyển dụng
lines: Hello, this is a message for Linh Nguyen. My name is Karen Wells, and I'm a recruiter at Talent Bridge.
Thank you for applying for the senior backend developer position with our client, Orbit Payments.
I'm happy to let you know that they were very impressed with your application.
They'd like to invite you to a first-round interview by video call.
The interview will last about forty-five minutes and will be with two members of their engineering team.
They've suggested either Tuesday at two p.m. or Thursday at ten a.m., Vietnam time.
Please let me know which time works better for you by end of day tomorrow.
You'll also be asked to solve a short coding problem during the call, so make sure you have a laptop with a working camera.
After the interview, I'll follow up with feedback within a few days.
You can reply to my e-mail or call me back at 555-0147.
Congratulations on getting this far, and I look forward to hearing from you.

questions.q: Why is the speaker calling?
o: To offer the listener a job
To invite the listener to an interview
questions.vi: "They'd like to invite you to a first-round interview". Bẫy: chưa phải mời nhận việc (job offer), chỉ là vòng phỏng vấn đầu.

questions.q: How long will the interview last?
o: About an hour and a half
questions.vi: "The interview will last about forty-five minutes". Bẫy: "two" là số người phỏng vấn và giờ "two p.m.", "ten" là "ten a.m.".

questions.q: What is the listener asked to do by tomorrow?
questions.vi: "let me know which time works better for you by end of day tomorrow" → chọn giờ phỏng vấn. Bẫy: laptop chỉ cần có camera, không phải mua mới.

questions.q: What will the listener do during the interview?
questions.vi: "You'll also be asked to solve a short coding problem" = giải bài lập trình (paraphrase). Bẫy: phỏng vấn với "two members of their engineering team", không phải CEO.

title: Factory tour
lines: Good morning, and welcome to Greenfield Electronics. I'm David, and I'll be your guide for today's tour of our main factory.
This plant produces around five thousand circuit boards every day, which are shipped to customers in over thirty countries.
The tour will take about an hour, and we'll start here in the assembly area.
After that, we'll move on to the testing lab, and then we'll see the packaging department.
Before we go in, please put on the safety glasses and the blue jackets you were given at reception.
They help protect our products from dust and static electricity.
Also, photography isn't permitted inside the testing lab, so please keep your phones in your pockets there.
The machines are quite loud in the assembly area, so stay close to me if you want to hear my explanations.
Trust me, you don't want to miss the robots.
At the end of the tour, we'll head to the cafeteria for some refreshments, and I'll be happy to answer any questions.
Alright, if everyone's ready, please follow me.

questions.q: Who most likely are the listeners?
questions.vi: "welcome to Greenfield Electronics... I'll be your guide for today's tour" → khách tham quan. Bẫy: "Factory workers" dùng lại từ factory nhưng họ không làm việc ở đó.

questions.q: Where will the tour begin?
questions.vi: "we'll start here in the assembly area". Bẫy: cafeteria là nơi kết thúc; reception là nơi đã nhận áo và kính.

questions.q: What are listeners asked to do before entering?
questions.vi: "put on the safety glasses and the blue jackets" = mặc đồ bảo hộ (paraphrase). Bẫy: điện thoại chỉ cần để trong túi ở phòng testing lab.

questions.q: Why does the speaker say, "Trust me, you don't want to miss the robots"?
o: To warn that the machines are dangerous
To explain why photos are not allowed
To point out an interesting part of the tour
To ask listeners to wait for the robots
questions.vi: Sau khi dặn "stay close to me", anh nhấn mạnh phần robot rất đáng xem. Bẫy: máy móc chỉ "loud" (ồn), không nói là nguy hiểm.

title: New project-tracking tool
title_vi: Hướng dẫn dùng công cụ quản lý dự án mới
lines: Today I'll walk you through TaskFlow, the project-tracking tool we're moving to next month.
We've been using spreadsheets and e-mail threads, and things have been slipping through the cracks.
First, open the link I sent this morning and sign in with your company account. You don't need to create a new password.
On the left, you'll see your projects. Click on one, and you'll get a board with three columns: To Do, In Progress, and Done.
To create a task, click the plus button, add a short title, and assign it to a team member.
Make sure you always set a due date. Tasks without one won't show up in the weekly report.
You can also attach files of up to twenty-five megabytes, but for anything bigger, please use a shared drive link.
The old spreadsheets will be switched to read-only on the fifteenth, and they'll be archived completely at the end of the month.
So any active tasks need to be moved into TaskFlow before the fifteenth.
Now, I'll give you ten minutes to create two or three sample tasks of your own.
If you get stuck, raise your hand and either Sam or I will come over.

questions.q: What is the main purpose of the workshop?
o: To train staff on new software
To choose a new tracking tool
questions.vi: "I'll walk you through TaskFlow, the project-tracking tool we're moving to" → đào tạo dùng phần mềm mới. Bẫy: công cụ đã được chọn rồi, không phải đang chọn.

questions.q: According to the speaker, why should a due date be set?
o: So the task can be assigned
So the task appears in a regular summary
So larger files can be attached
So the task moves to the Done column
questions.vi: "Tasks without one won't show up in the weekly report" → báo cáo hằng tuần = regular summary (paraphrase). Bẫy: "assign it to a team member" là bước khác.

questions.q: By when must active tasks be transferred?
o: By the end of the month
By the end of next month
questions.vi: "any active tasks need to be moved into TaskFlow before the fifteenth". Bẫy: "end of the month" là lúc lưu trữ hẳn bảng tính cũ; "ten minutes" là thời gian thực hành.

questions.q: What will listeners most likely do next?
questions.vi: "I'll give you ten minutes to create two or three sample tasks" → thực hành tạo task. Bẫy: Sam chỉ hỗ trợ khi bị kẹt; không cần mật khẩu mới.

title: Quarterly results
lines: Thanks, everyone. Let's move on to our results for the third quarter.
Overall, it was a strong quarter. Total revenue reached four point two million dollars, up eight percent from the second quarter.
Most of that growth came from our cloud services, which now make up nearly half of our sales.
Our mobile app subscriptions also did well, especially in Japan and Australia.
On the other hand, hardware sales dropped by about five percent.
That wasn't a big surprise, since we stopped producing two older models in July.
We also kept costs under control, mainly by reducing travel and moving more meetings online.
As a result, our profit margin improved slightly.
Looking ahead, we expect the fourth quarter to be even busier, with the holiday season and two major product launches.
I'll send the full report to everyone by end of day, so please take a look before our planning session on Monday.
Now, let's open it up for questions.

questions.q: What is the speaker mainly discussing?
questions.vi: "our results for the third quarter... Total revenue" → kết quả tài chính. Bẫy: "product launches" và "reducing travel" chỉ là chi tiết.

questions.q: By how much did total revenue increase?
questions.vi: "up eight percent from the second quarter". Bẫy: "five percent" là mức giảm của hardware; "half" là tỉ trọng cloud.

questions.q: Why does the speaker say, "That wasn't a big surprise"?
o: Cloud sales always grow in summer
The app was popular in Japan
questions.vi: Câu này nói về việc "hardware sales dropped" vì "we stopped producing two older models" → sụt giảm đã được dự đoán.

questions.q: What are listeners asked to do before Monday?
questions.vi: "please take a look before our planning session on Monday" → đọc bản báo cáo (paraphrase "Read a document"). Bẫy: "planning" không có nghĩa là lên kế hoạch ra mắt sản phẩm.

title: Coworking space ad
title_vi: Quảng cáo không gian làm việc chung
lines: Tired of working from your kitchen table? Or paying too much for an office you only use three days a week?
Then come and check out HubWorks, the newest coworking space in the city center.
Located just two minutes from Central Station, HubWorks offers fast Wi-Fi, quiet phone booths, and meeting rooms you can book online.
Our members also enjoy free coffee, a rooftop terrace, and regular networking events with local start-ups.
A flexible desk costs just one hundred and fifty dollars a month, and a private office for up to four people starts at six hundred.
And this month only, new members get their first two weeks absolutely free.
Not sure if it's right for you? Book a free tour on our website, and see the space for yourself.
We're open from seven a.m. to ten p.m. on weekdays, and members with a private office have access twenty-four hours a day.
Visit hubworks dot com today, and use the code START to get ten percent off your first month.

questions.q: What is being advertised?
questions.vi: "the newest coworking space" = không gian làm việc chung. Bẫy: "free coffee", "Central Station" chỉ là chi tiết.

questions.q: What is offered to new members this month?
questions.vi: "new members get their first two weeks absolutely free". Bẫy: "ten percent off" là mã giảm giá tháng đầu, không phải phiếu cà phê.

questions.q: What are listeners encouraged to do if they are unsure?
questions.vi: "Book a free tour on our website" = đặt lịch tham quan trực tuyến (paraphrase). Bẫy: networking events là quyền lợi của thành viên.

questions.q: Who can use the space at any time of day?
questions.vi: "members with a private office have access twenty-four hours a day". Bẫy: thành viên thường chỉ vào được 7 a.m.–10 p.m. ngày thường.

title: Fire drill this afternoon
title_vi: Diễn tập phòng cháy chiều nay
lines: Hi, everyone, this is Mark from Facilities. Just a quick heads-up about this afternoon.
We'll be holding a fire drill at around three fifteen, not at two as stated in last week's e-mail.
When the alarm goes off, please stop what you're doing and leave the building by the nearest staircase.
Do not use the elevators under any circumstances.
Our meeting point is the parking lot behind the building, not the front entrance where we gathered last time.
Floor wardens will be wearing orange vests, and they'll check that each area is empty.
Once you reach the parking lot, please find your team leader so they can confirm you're there.
The whole drill should take about twenty minutes, so you'll be back at your desks by around three thirty-five.
I know some of you have client calls this afternoon.
If you can't avoid one, let your manager know before lunch, and we'll see what we can do.
Last year, it took us almost eight minutes to get everyone out. This time, we're aiming for under five.

questions.q: Who most likely is the speaker?
questions.vi: "this is Mark from Facilities" → nhân viên bộ phận cơ sở vật chất. Bẫy: "floor wardens" và "team leader" là những người khác được nhắc tới.

questions.q: Where should employees gather during the drill?
questions.vi: "the parking lot behind the building" → phía sau tòa nhà. Bẫy: "front entrance" là điểm tập trung lần trước; staircase là lối thoát.

questions.q: What should employees do after arriving at the meeting point?
o: Check that each area is empty
questions.vi: "please find your team leader so they can confirm you're there" = báo danh với trưởng nhóm. Bẫy: áo cam và kiểm tra khu vực là việc của floor wardens.

questions.q: Why does the speaker say, "I know some of you have client calls this afternoon"?
o: To recognize a possible scheduling conflict
To ask staff to move all meetings
To remind managers about a deadline
questions.vi: Anh thừa nhận buổi diễn tập có thể trùng cuộc gọi khách hàng, rồi nói "let your manager know before lunch, and we'll see what we can do". Bẫy: không hủy diễn tập, cũng không bắt dời mọi cuộc họp.

title: Wrong items delivered
title_vi: Nhà cung cấp giao nhầm hàng
lines: Hello, this is Jenny Lopez from Prime Office Supplies, calling for Mr. Tran at Bluewave Software.
I'm calling about your order of office chairs that was delivered yesterday.
Unfortunately, our warehouse made a mistake. You ordered twenty black chairs, but we sent you twenty gray ones.
We'll deliver the correct chairs this Thursday morning, between nine and eleven.
Our driver will pick up the gray chairs at the same time, so please keep them in their original boxes if possible.
Of course, there's no extra charge for this.
And to apologize, we'll take fifteen percent off your next order.
Could you call me back to confirm that someone will be at the office on Thursday to receive the delivery?
Again, sorry for the trouble, and thank you for your patience.

questions.q: What is the purpose of the message?
o: To report a problem with an order
To request payment for a delivery
questions.vi: "our warehouse made a mistake" về đơn ghế → báo lỗi đơn hàng. Bẫy: "no extra charge" nên không phải đòi tiền.

questions.q: What was wrong with the delivery?
o: The chairs were the wrong color
questions.vi: "You ordered twenty black chairs, but we sent you twenty gray ones" → sai màu. Bẫy: số lượng vẫn là 20, đủ.

questions.q: What does the speaker offer?
o: A discount on a future order
questions.vi: "we'll take fifteen percent off your next order" = giảm giá đơn sau (paraphrase). Bẫy: "twenty" là số ghế đã đặt.

questions.q: What is the listener asked to do?
o: Return the chairs to the warehouse
Confirm that someone can receive a delivery
questions.vi: "call me back to confirm that someone will be at the office on Thursday". Bẫy: tài xế sẽ tự đến lấy ghế xám, người nghe không phải mang trả.

title: New app release briefing
title_vi: Giới thiệu tính năng bản app mới
lines: Hi, team. I want to give you a quick overview of version 3.0 of our mobile banking app, which goes live next Tuesday.
The biggest change is the new home screen. Users can now see all their accounts and recent transactions in one place.
We've also added fingerprint and face login, which our customers have been asking for since last year.
Another new feature is instant transfers between our bank and five partner banks.
Those transfers used to take up to two business days, so this is a big deal.
On top of that, the app now supports dark mode and loads about thirty percent faster.
Since you're the ones who'll be answering customers' questions, it's important that you understand these changes.
We'll run a short training session on Monday afternoon, and I'll share a one-page summary right after this meeting.
If customers report any bugs, please log them in the support system with screenshots, and tag them 'version three'.
The development team will be monitoring those reports closely during the first week.
Okay, let's take a look at a quick demo.

questions.q: Who most likely are the listeners?
questions.vi: "you're the ones who'll be answering customers' questions" và "log them in the support system" → nhân viên hỗ trợ khách hàng. Bẫy: "development team" được nhắc như một nhóm khác.

questions.q: Why does the speaker say, "this is a big deal"?
o: To stress that a feature is a major improvement
To warn about a security risk
To announce a new partnership deal
questions.vi: Chuyển khoản trước đây "used to take up to two business days", nay là tức thì → cải tiến lớn. Bẫy: "deal" ở đây không phải hợp đồng với "partner banks".

questions.q: When will the training session be held?
questions.vi: "a short training session on Monday afternoon". Bẫy: thứ Ba là ngày ra mắt app; "right after this meeting" là lúc gửi bản tóm tắt.

questions.q: What will most likely happen next?
questions.vi: "let's take a look at a quick demo" → sẽ xem bản demo. Bẫy: app ra mắt "next Tuesday", không phải ngay sau đó.

title: AI in customer service
title_vi: AI trong chăm sóc khách hàng
lines: Thank you. It's great to be here.
When we first introduced an AI chat assistant at our company three years ago, I'll admit I was skeptical.
Our customer service team was handling about eight thousand inquiries a week, and I worried that a chatbot would just frustrate people.
Well, I was wrong. Today, the assistant resolves around sixty percent of inquiries on its own, without any human involvement.
Average waiting time has dropped from twelve minutes to under two.
But here's what surprised me most: our customer satisfaction scores actually went up.
That's because our human agents now spend their time on the complicated cases, where empathy really matters.
We didn't cut a single job. Instead, we retrained our staff to handle escalations and to review the AI's answers.
Of course, it wasn't all smooth. In the first few months, the assistant gave some incorrect answers about refunds.
So my advice is simple: start small, keep humans in the loop, and measure everything.
In a moment, I'll show you some real conversations, and you can judge the results for yourselves.

questions.q: What is the talk mainly about?
o: Reducing the number of support staff
One company's experience with AI support
questions.vi: Cả bài kể kết quả khi công ty "introduced an AI chat assistant" → trải nghiệm dùng AI hỗ trợ khách hàng. Bẫy: "We didn't cut a single job" nên không phải cắt giảm nhân sự.

questions.q: Why does the speaker say, "Well, I was wrong"?
o: The assistant turned out to be effective
She chose the wrong software vendor
questions.vi: Cô từng "skeptical" và lo chatbot làm khách bực, nhưng thực tế AI tự giải quyết 60% yêu cầu → hóa ra hiệu quả. Bẫy: "incorrect answers" là lỗi của AI, không phải của cô.

questions.q: What does the speaker say about the company's support staff?
o: Some of them were let go
They answer sixty percent of inquiries
They now review refund requests only
They focus on more difficult cases
questions.vi: "human agents now spend their time on the complicated cases" = tập trung vào ca khó (paraphrase). Bẫy: 60% là phần AI tự xử lý, không phải nhân viên.

questions.q: What will the speaker most likely do next?
questions.vi: "I'll show you some real conversations" → trình bày ví dụ hội thoại thực tế. Bẫy: không nhắc tới phần hỏi đáp hay diễn giả khác.
